Storage broker methods must use SQL nouns: Select, Insert, Update, or Delete.

Back to STXB rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

Storage broker methods must use SQL nouns: Select, Insert, Update, or Delete. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Brokers family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXB007: Storage broker methods must use SQL nouns: Select, Insert, Update, or Delete.
ValueTask<Student> GetStudent(Guid studentId) => db.GetAsync(studentId);

Good code example

// Follows STXB007
ValueTask<Student> SelectStudent(Guid studentId) => db.SelectAsync(studentId);
